name: Shivaya Vishnu Rupaya
text:
शिवाय विष्णुरूपाय शिवरूपाय विष्णवे ।
शिवस्य हृदयं विष्णुर्विष्णोश्च हृदयं शिवः ॥
meaning: Salutations to Shiva, who is Vishnu in form, and to Vishnu, who is Shiva in form. Vishnu is the heart of Shiva, and Shiva the heart of Vishnu.
purpose: A verse on the unity of Shiva and Vishnu.
supports: Softening divisions; seeing one presence in many forms.
when: In a practice that honours more than one form of the divine.
